items.title: Hackers Weaponizing OAuth Applications for Persistent Cloud Access Even After Password Reset

items.title: Too Many Secrets: Attackers Pounce on Sensitive Data Sprawl
items.description: Hardcoded credentials, access tokens, and API keys are ending up in the darnedest places, prompting a call for organizations to stop over-privileging secrets.
